metadata.description: 50 synthetic prompts for VSS-1 parser testing across 4 categories per F13 SOVEREIGN ratification. AAA-owned test contract — any parser implementation must pass these.

categories.A_simple_grounding: 10 cases — single object + direct spatial context
categories.B_ambiguity_underspecification: 15 cases — ambiguous prompts; ambiguity MUST be preserved
categories.D_adversarial_non_visual: 10 cases — abstract/non-visual; entities either rejected or moved to unsupported_claims
